results.summary: This project sets KS-Signal railway signal aspects based on track information. Inputs include track1_free, track2_free, pre_signal, allow shunting, Vorsicht and shorter breaking distance, and the outputs drive green, orange, red, yellow and white signal lamps. It simply switches lamps on and off on toggle, and is tested by connecting the clock and buttons as inputs and the LEDs as outputs in the documented order. The design is implemented in Wokwi and requires a clock, nine buttons and a set of coloured LEDs as external hardware.
